content.short: Capricorn is a concentrated liquidity DEX on Monad combining oracle pricing with fast execution.
content.description: Capricorn pairs concentrated liquidity with oracle-driven pricing on Monad, aiming at execution quality closer to a professional venue than a typical AMM. Designs like this depend on the chain keeping pace with the oracle, which is the specific bet Monad's throughput is meant to support.
content.meta: Oracle-priced concentrated liquidity on Monad, aimed at execution closer to a professional venue.
